description: Uitdagingen-curation (Landelijk Gebied & Natuur): compositie-verscherping, uitbreidingsband en de aandachts-tegenbeeld op een pure-inclusion-track.

scenarios.name: Only bovenlokale dagrecreatieterreinen remain open
scenarios.description: Drops FR-RC-02 (art. 9.23, recreatiezone 136.3 km²) from the inclusion composition — strict programming limited to art. 9.22.

basis.provenanceNote: NC-RC-02 (art. 9.23) opens the recreatiezone 'in afwijking van artikel 9.3'; this variant documents the strictest programming reading by dropping it from the composition.

scenarios.name: Dagrecreatieterrein designation expanded by a 500 m band
scenarios.description: Buffers the art. 9.22 inclusion (FR-RC-01, 81.8 km²) outward by 500 m — an expansion-band variant.

basis.variedAspect: inclusion zone widened by an added 500 m buffer; the designation is cited, the 500 m band is the scenario's own parameter
basis.provenanceNote: NC-RC-01 (art. 9.22) carries the dagrecreatieterrein designation; the 500 m band is not cited and is the scenario's own parameter.

scenarios.name: Dagrecreatieterrein opening demoted to attention marker
scenarios.description: FR-RC-01 re-read as an attention marker instead of an inclusion — measures what the art.-9.22 opening itself is worth (−81.8 km²).

basis.provenanceNote: NC-RC-01 (art. 9.22) opens the designation 'in afwijking van artikel 9.3'; this variant documents the counter-reading in which no spatial opening follows, only attention.
